ns3_matrix_replay.upstream: ns-3-alibabacloud commit/archive source retained under original .scratch path
ns3_matrix_replay.build: In the pinned upstream simulation checkout, register/replace scratch/MfgMatrixReplay.cc with this source, then run ./ns3 build scratch_MfgMatrixReplay.

taot_official_sinkhorn_source.runtime_use: Optional external TAOT comparison only; the frozen V2 Sinkhorn operator runs without importing this vendor source.

physical_g4_fused_ports.warning: The bundled historical timing runner contains its original deadline and source-workspace paths; it is provenance, not the portable V2 runner. Use tools/physical_g4_qualify.py --mode zero-template for the portable CPU structural check. No new four-rank physical run is claimed.

physical_g4_fresh_runner.default_deadline: none; optional caller-supplied future timezone-aware ISO-8601 deadline
physical_g4_fresh_runner.external_asset_preflight: Before importing Torch, require every model-manifest file at its pinned byte size and a local compiled schedule library; missing assets fail without network access.

offline_policy: V2 never downloads or installs dependencies implicitly; optional external executions use only caller-supplied local assets.
